name: Horse Sense
body:
Source Pathfinder #132: The Six-Legend Soul pg. 73
You take Grand Prince Beldam I’s insistence upon the resilience of simple creatures to heart, emulating them to shield yourself from complex mental effects.

Prerequisites: Wis 15, Iron Will.

Benefit: When you attempt a saving throw against an enchantment effect that cannot affect an animal (such as charm person), you can roll the saving throw twice and take the better result.
